summary: Recommends that collections in the Ansible community package use antsibull-changelog so their changelogs can be merged into the combined Ansible release changelog.
questions: What tool should I use to generate changelogs for my collection?
How does the Ansible release changelog include each collection's changes?

answer_card.title: Changelogs for collections
answer_card.answer_md: If your collection is in the Ansible community package, use **antsibull-changelog**. Ansible uses its output to build one combined changelog for each release.
